request.predicate: eligible recovered source with nonempty original parser diagnostics

mandatory_fixtures.scope: Separate ownership and future-checker fixture specifications; no execution metric is implied by this inventory.

E8.selection_and_dependencies: same frozen variant IDs and ordered closure

operation_matrix.scope: Source static call closure plus separately reviewed callback/interface/construction boundaries; not function parity

predicates.content_mapper_execution: effective runExternalCode == true and configured content mappers nonempty
predicates.emitted_output_only: NoTypesAndSymbols true and emitted baseline present and no errors/types/symbols baseline for exact configured name
predicates.type_arguments: nonempty Node.TypeArguments on the pinned supported payload kinds
